parsed.main_gap: Section 3's cut-count bound |A|+|B|-1 for the common-refinement construction is asserted with 'details omitted'; it is exactly what (13) needs for tightness, so the routine count should have been written out.

errors.description: The overlay construction's key quantitative claim (at most |A|+|B|-1 cuts, unpaired material only in A of length p-q) is not verified. The count is routine (≤|B|-1 cuts in A at B's division points, ≤1 extra cut at position q, ≤|A|-1 cuts in B at A's division points inside (0,q)), and it does hold, but the write-up leaves it to the reader.
errors.quote: the bound on the number of cuts follows by counting the cells of the common refinement (standard; details omitted).

parsed.notes: Answer c=2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) with a correct structure: claiming value = alternating discrepancy (verified induction), min-pairing characterization, powers-of-two construction with a tree-component parity argument for the lower bound, and a subset-sum pigeonhole plus overlay construction for the upper bound. All checked steps are correct; only the overlay cut count is left unwritten.
